messages.title: 九境 Ninefold · Welcome
body: An idle cultivation game. Qi gathers on its own, even with the phone closed, and you climb nine realms and the nine heavens above them.
**Play:** https://hyoddougamer-dev.github.io/ninefold/
**Android app:** https://github.com/hyoddougamer-dev/ninefold/releases/download/testers/ninefold.apk
On iPhone, open the game in Safari and tap Share → Add to Home Screen.
**Where things go:** a problem to 報 bugs, an idea to 議 ideas, and where you are in the game to 記 journal.
Losing a fight never costs anything. Try everything.

messages.title: 規 The rules
body: **1.** Be kind. This is a small community and everyone here is helping.
**2.** The game is in closed test. Ask before sharing it outside the server.
**3.** One bug per post in 報 bugs, so nothing gets lost.
**4.** No spam, no advertising, nothing you would not show a stranger.

messages.title: 告 Ninefold: the first closed test
body: Hey everyone. This is the new home for **九境 Ninefold**, the game I have been building since Dao of the Endless Sky closed.

It is an idle cultivation game, painted in ink. You gather qi, climb nine realms of nine layers, and cross the tribulation into nine heavens above the summit. Every beast is painted by hand, every realm has its own landscape, and people you meet on the road remember what you did.
It is built around one promise: **nothing is ever taken away for being away.** Close it for a week and your cultivator is further along, never behind.
**What I need from you:** play it the way you would if nobody was watching. Open it when you feel like it. Then tell me what confused you, what annoyed you, and what made you come back.
**Play:** https://hyoddougamer-dev.github.io/ninefold/
**Android app:** https://github.com/hyoddougamer-dev/ninefold/releases/download/testers/ninefold.apk
Bugs go to 報 bugs, ideas to 議 ideas. Thank you for being here.

messages.title: 告 How to report a bug
body: Open a new post in 報 bugs and say three things:
**1.** What you did.
**2.** What you expected to happen.
**3.** What happened instead.
Add a screenshot and the Build line from the bottom of the ≡ menu (top right corner). If the game showed an error, copy its text too.
